notes: IBK India is wholesale/corporate banking. No retail deposit products in India.

gap_classification.notes: IBK has a New Delhi branch (foreign bank presence per IFSC directories) but operates as a wholesale/corporate foreign bank. The global IBK site (global.ibk.co.kr) lists country operations (USA, China, Japan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Russia, Nepal) but no India-specific retail deposit page exists. No retail FD product / India rate card published.
